title: Seacrest Beach "Seawall" 84 A Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Complete home renovation inside and out- 4 adult bikes- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $50 per day.- Easy access to 30A and bike path- Short Walking/Biking Distance to Alys and Rosemary Beach- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Nestled within Inlet Beach along the iconic Emerald Coast, Seawall is an inviting 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home that sleeps 10 in 2,750 square feet. This coastal gem offers convenient access to 30A and biking trails, located near renowned Alys and Rosemary Beach for shopping and dining. Revel in stunning Gulf views and ocean sounds from the inviting decks and private poolside patio—less than 1 block from gated beach access!The spacious outdoor entertainment areas on the first floor set the tone for a sun-soaked getaway in this classic 3-story Florida beach house. Enjoy the refreshing pool or gather around the picnic table for an alfresco meal from the grill. A covered patio with plush furniture offers respite from the sun, while the enclosed outdoor shower boasts hot water and a comfortable changing area. Inside, 2 bedrooms complete this floor—1 guest bedroom with a private bathroom and queen bed, and 1 spacious primary with a king bed, deluxe cast iron soaking tub in the private bathroom, and patio access.The second floor is the heart of this professionally furnished and decorated home, characterized by white shiplap walls and hardwood flooring in the spacious open floor plan. Gather with friends and family in the welcoming living area, where 2 comfortable slipcovered couches and a large 70” TV invite guests to unwind. Delight in the well-equipped kitchen with new high-end appliances, including a 4-burner electric oven and Bosch refrigerator, complemented by granite countertops. Savor meals in the traditional dining area with rattan seating for 7, surrounded by scenic neighborhood views. Experience the calming sounds of the Gulf on the screened-in porch overlooking the pool, featuring a 6-person dining table, outdoor couch, and direct pool access from a gated stairway. The vibrant guest bedroom offers a cozy retreat with a plush queen bed, 43” TV, and direct balcony access. A new washer and dryer adds convenience.The third-floor guest bedroom offers 2 queen beds and a 70” TV, while the open sleeping area boasts a full-over-full bunk bed—both share balcony access with peek-a-boo water views.On-site parking for 4 vehicles, plus 4 complimentary adult bikes, makes 30A exploration easy while staying at Seawall. For direct beach access, head south on A Street, turn right onto 30A, and find the trail between houses 8858 and 8870 for fun in the sun. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:--Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Additional Sleeping Area: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed
